data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for native Naver Login SDKs on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that integrates native Naver Login SDKs for Android and iOS. It allows users to sign in and out using Naver accounts and fetch user profile details and tokens.
use_when: You need Naver social authentication in a Flutter application.
Targeting platforms like Android and iOS where native Naver Login SDKs are used.
avoid_when: You do not require Naver authentication.
Building for desktop or web where native SDK integration is not supported.
strengths: Supports native Naver Login SDKs on Android and iOS.
Provides helper methods for user account data and token management.
weaknesses: Requires manual native platform setup for Android (strings.xml, AndroidManifest) and iOS (Info.plist, AppDelegate).
data.setup_notes: Requires client IDs and secrets configured in Android strings.xml and iOS Info.plist, alongside updates to MainActivity and AppDelegate.
